response.sql: WITH j AS (SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, s.optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord r ON s.transref = r.transreg JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg), pairs AS (SELECT transref, tradekind, AVG(optvolrt) AS avg_opt FROM j GROUP BY transref, tradekind), overall AS (SELECT AVG(optvolrt) AS o FROM j), dev AS (SELECT p.transref, p.tradekind, p.avg_opt, ABS(p.avg_opt - o.o) AS dev FROM pairs p JOIN overall o ON o.o IS NOT NULL WHERE p.avg_opt IS NOT NULL), typed AS (SELECT tradekind, avg_opt, dev, AVG(dev) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS td FROM dev WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL) SELECT tradekind, AVG(avg_opt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio, AVG(dev) AS avg_deviation, AVG(dev - td) AS avg_excess FROM typed WHERE dev > td GROUP BY tradekind

assumptions.assumption: The overall average option volume ratio is the average of optvolrt over all fully matched sentiment rows (sentiment joined to transaction and trader), ignoring NULLs.
Deviation is the absolute difference between a pair's average optvolrt and the overall average.

A pair beats the type's average deviation when its deviation is strictly greater. The type's average deviation is taken over all pairs of that type with a non-null deviation. The excess is the pair's deviation minus that average.

alternatives.interpretation: The overall average is the average of the pair-level averages, not of the individual rows.
